user.title: LumaPresence
user.description: Name this instance and choose the lights the simulation may control.

data_description.lights: Lights and switches the simulation may control.

facades.title: Facades
facades.description: Mark the simulation lights visible from the street (front) or from the back of the house (rear). The rest count as interior lights.

data_description.front_lights: Visible from the street. A minimum of them is kept on while simulating.
data_description.rear_lights: Visible from the back of the house. A minimum of them is kept on while simulating.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Choose where LumaPresence learns how the house is really used. Every light in these floors and areas is learned, except disabled and hidden entities and configuration or diagnostic entities such as status LEDs. Simulation lights are always learned.

data_description.learn_floors: Lights in every area of these floors are learned.
data_description.learn_areas: Indoor areas that do not belong to any of the floors above.
data_description.learn_extra: For example relays exposed as switches, or lamps without an area.
data_description.learn_only_human: Ignore light changes made by automations and scripts.

presence.title: People and alarm
presence.description: Learning pauses while the house is empty.

data_description.persons: When none of these people is home, the house counts as empty and learning stops.
data_description.alarm_entity: Learning stops while this alarm is armed away.
data_description.margin_before_hours: Hours of activity discarded just before an absence is detected.
data_description.margin_after_hours: Hours learning stays paused after coming back.

sequences.title: Night sequences
sequences.description: Timing of each night route. Each wait is a random value between its minimum and its maximum.

data_description.step_delay_min: Time between one light and the next while walking.
data_description.step_delay_max: Time between one light and the next while walking.
data_description.dwell_min: Time the destination light stays on before walking back.

user.title: Route
user.description: A path someone walks at night: from the origin (for example the bedroom), along the path lights in order, to the destination (for example the bathroom), and back. Route lights do not need to be simulation lights.

data_description.origin: Light turned on first, for example the bedroom light.
data_description.path: Lights in between, in walking order, for example the hallway.
data_description.destination: Light where the walk ends, for example the bathroom light.

reconfigure.title: Route
reconfigure.description: A path someone walks at night: from the origin (for example the bedroom), along the path lights in order, to the destination (for example the bathroom), and back. Route lights do not need to be simulation lights.

data_description.origin: Light turned on first, for example the bedroom light.
data_description.path: Lights in between, in walking order, for example the hallway.
data_description.destination: Light where the walk ends, for example the bathroom light.

error.same_origin_destination: The origin and the destination must be different lights.
error.duplicate_light: Each light can appear only once in a route.
